display.purpose: Page-defining hero heading (H1). Always Midnight Pine. One per screen.

title-prominent.purpose: Toolbar titles. Bolder weight at smaller size for limited toolbar height.

body.purpose: Default running text. Cap line length at 65–75ch.

body-small.purpose: Post titles in feed cards, secondary content blocks.

caption.purpose: Supporting metadata, body-band displays, chart axis labels. Always Muted Pewter.

label.purpose: Badges, tag chips, status pills. Wider tracking earns the smaller size.

stat.purpose: Insight metrics, dashboard numbers, earnings figures. Always Midnight Pine, with tabular figures when stacked.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on interactive cards, follow buttons, selectable cards. Pine-tinted.

shadows.name: ambient-mid
shadows.purpose: Modals, dropdowns, action sheets, quiz transitions during entry.

shadows.name: ambient-high
shadows.purpose: Full-screen sheets, image-cropper overlays, lifted creator-tool surfaces.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Everyday separator. Toolbar bottom edges, list dividers, card outlines on same-tone backgrounds.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, selection).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: State changes: hover, focus, selection commit.

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: fadeSlideUp page transitions, quiz step entrances.

motion.name: fade-slide-up
motion.value: @keyframes fadeSlideUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
motion.purpose: Page and step entrance. Animates transform + opacity only.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column feed, full-width cards, stacked navigation.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column feed grid, onboarding container with side margins.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Three-column feed grid, retailer dashboards expand to multi-column stat grids.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's principal action. Midnight Pine, Parchment text, soft 14px corners, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0E3A3B; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0C3334; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(14, 58, 59, 0.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E3A3B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Non-destructive secondary action. Outline of Midnight Pine on transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #0E3A3B; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #0E3A3B; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(14, 58, 59, 0.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E3A3B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent CTA Button
components.description: The Mustard CTA. Pill-shaped, used for the single primary action on a page (quiz start, take the quiz, complete onboarding). Reserved per the Mustard-Is-Action Rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #D1A72E; color: #2A2D32; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 24px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #B89328; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(14, 58, 59, 0.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E3A3B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Body-Band Display
components.description: The signature LYKE component. Renders a body profile as a band, never as exact stats. Three facets joined by middle-dots: height range, frame size, fit preference.
components.html: 5'4"–5'6" · medium frame · fitted preference
components.css: .ds-body-band { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #6B6F76; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-band-sep { color: #B0B3B8; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: Content-feed card. Image-forward, with a creator avatar overlapping the bottom of the media (the signature LYKE pattern). Body-band sits below the creator name.
components.html:
Jordan B.
5'4"–5'6" · medium frame · fitted

Wide-leg cropped denim, size 8 — runs true to size, slightly long for petite.
components.css: .ds-post-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 18px; overflow: visible; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-post-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(14, 58, 59, 0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-media-wrap { position: relative; overflow: visible; } .ds-media-clip { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0; background: #E3E0DA; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; } .ds-media-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E3E0DA, #D6D2CB); } .ds-post-avatar { position: absolute; bottom: -26px; left: 14px; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #FFFFFF; z-index: 2; } .ds-creator-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; padding: 30px 14px 10px; } .ds-creator-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-creator-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #2A2D32; } .ds-body-info { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #6B6F76; } .ds-follow-btn { flex-shrink: 0; background: transparent; color: #0E3A3B; border: 1px solid #0E3A3B; border-radius: 20px; padding: 0 14px; height: 30px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-follow-btn:hover { background: rgba(14, 58, 59, 0.08); } .ds-post-content { padding: 0 14px 14px; } .ds-post-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #2A2D32; }

components.name: Selectable Card
components.description: The onboarding/quiz selection pattern. Decisive committed state (no half-tints) when selected. Used for body type, frame size, fit preference, and quiz answers.
components.css: .ds-selectable-card { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid #E3E0DA; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; position: relative; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-selectable-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(14, 58, 59, 0.08); } .ds-selectable-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E3A3B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-selectable--selected { border-color: #0E3A3B; background: rgba(14, 58, 59, 0.08); } .ds-check { position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 14px; display: inline-flex; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-selectable--selected .ds-check { opacity: 1; } .ds-sel-name { display: block; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2A2D32; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-sel-desc { display: block; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #6B6F76; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill chip used for product tags, sort filters, and body-band components. Primary variant indicates active filter state.
components.html: Dresses5'4–5'6True to size
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; background: #E3E0DA; color: #2A2D32; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.4; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #D6D2CB; } .ds-chip--primary { background: #0E3A3B; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Warm Ash fill, no border at rest. Decisive 2px Pine focus ring (not a glow).
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #6B6F76; } .ds-input { background: #E3E0DA; color: #2A2D32; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; transition: outline-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B6F76; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #0E3A3B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Top-of-page toolbar. Parchment surface, hairline bottom border, prominent title. Stays flat through scroll.
components.html: For you
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; height: 56px; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(42, 45, 50, 0.08); font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #2A2D32; } .ds-toolbar-btn { background: transparent; border: none; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-toolbar-btn:hover { background: rgba(42, 45, 50, 0.06); } .ds-toolbar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0E3A3B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Retailer-insight stat card. Apple Health register: large Pine number, small Pewter label, no decorative chrome, no gradient. The deliberate inverse of the SaaS hero-metric template.
components.html: Engagement, 5'4"–5'6" band3,412+8.2% vs prior 7d
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px 18px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 400; color: #6B6F76; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0E3A3B; line-height: 1.2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-trend { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #5B8C5A; }

narrative.overview: LYKE is a fitting room with honest light. The shopper walks in with a real question (will this fit a body like mine?) and the room is calm enough to think in. Surfaces are soft and matte. Type is clear and unhurried. Imagery is real people under daylight, not magazine retouching. Nothing on the wall is shouting. The system rejects, by name, the visual languages of Instagram, TikTok, fast fashion, influencer gloss, and tech-startup neon, and rejects the white-and-teal SaaS reflex that's the default failure mode for 'calm and minimal'. Calm is not the same as bland; restraint is not the same as emptiness. The system is split across two tonal registers that share the same vocabulary. Content surfaces (feed, post detail, creator profiles, my-posts) follow Everlane: image-forward, editorial restraint, typography that lets photography speak. Data surfaces (retailer insights, body-profile editing, the style quiz, charts) follow Apple Health: ranges and bands as native units, generous breathing room around numbers, type-led hierarchy with no decorative chrome. The same color palette and the same component primitives serve both.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal layering (Soft Stone to Warm Ash to Parchment) does most of the depth work.
Components are tactile and confident: soft corners, decisive states, never half-greyed.
Calm pacing in motion (state transitions only, never theatrical).
Bands and ranges, not exact measurements, in every body-profile surface.
Real, naturally-lit photography. Filters and gradients are forbidden on people.

rules.name: The Mustard-Is-Action Rule
rules.body: Aged Mustard appears only on elements that exist to be acted on, or that confirm an action just happened. Decorative use is prohibited. If Mustard appears on more than one element per screen, the second one is wrong.

rules.name: The Tonal-Stack Rule
rules.body: Page to Card to Surface depth is conveyed by stepping through Soft Stone to Warm Ash to Parchment, in that order. A Parchment card directly on Soft Stone is acceptable when the card is genuinely floating; a Warm Ash card on Soft Stone is acceptable inside dense lists. Other combinations are not.

rules.name: The No-Body-Filter Rule
rules.body: Color treatments (gradients, vignettes, tints, color-grading) are never applied to imagery containing people. The platform's value collapses if a creator's photo starts looking like an Instagram filter preset. This rule supersedes any other styling guidance.

rules.name: The One-Pine-Heading Rule
rules.body: Midnight Pine on type is reserved for one heading per screen (the H1 / Display) and for stat values. Section heads (H2) and below are Charcoal Ink. This keeps the eye's path through the page unambiguous.

rules.name: The Tracking-Compensates-Size Rule
rules.body: Tighten tracking as size grows (-0.01em from 1.15rem upward); widen it as size shrinks (0.02em at the Label step). Body and Caption stay at normal. A flat letter-spacing system feels mechanical; a varied scale feels considered.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If you find yourself adding box-shadow to a static element, you're solving a hierarchy problem with the wrong tool. Use the tonal stack and a hairline first.

rules.name: The Pine-Tinted-Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows carry a hint of Midnight Pine (rgba(14, 58, 59, ...)) rather than pure black. Pure-black shadows on warm neutrals look blue-ish and 'off'; brand-tinted shadows feel like part of the system.

dos: Do use the tonal stack (Soft Stone, Warm Ash, Parchment) for depth before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep Aged Mustard reserved for action and confirmation. Decorative Mustard is wrong.
Do show body-profile data as bands, never exact stats. 5'4 to 5'6, fitted preference, never 5'5, 132lb.
Do use Midnight Pine on H1 and Stat values only. Section heads (H2) and below stay Charcoal Ink.
Do tint shadows toward Midnight Pine (rgba(14, 58, 59, ...)) rather than pure black.
Do lift selectable cards and post cards on hover with ambient-low. Static informational cards stay flat.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion. The fadeSlideUp and fadeIn keyframes must degrade to instant or fade-only when the system requests it.
Do pair color with shape, position, label, or pattern in any chart or status indicator. Color-blind safety is non-negotiable on retailer data viz.
Do photograph people under natural light, with the diversity of bodies the platform actually serves. Real bodies, no smoothing.
Do use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) on Stat type when numbers stack vertically.
donts: Don't apply gradients, vignettes, tints, or color-grading to imagery containing people. Ever. (The No-Body-Filter Rule.)
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text plus gradient). Use solid color; emphasize via weight or size.
Don't default to glassmorphism or blur backdrops. Rare and purposeful, or nothing.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent). It's the SaaS cliche LYKE explicitly rejects.
Don't build a feed that looks like Instagram. No double-tap-to-like animations, no story rings, no engagement-bait pacing.
Don't build retailer surfaces that feel like surveillance dashboards. Aggregated bands only. Read more like a research report than a CCTV monitor.
Don't reach for a modal as the first thought. Exhaust inline and progressive alternatives first.
Don't use #000 or #fff directly. Charcoal Ink and Parchment are the project's near-black and near-white.
Don't use urgency timers, 'X people viewing this', or any fast-fashion engagement-bait pattern. Reassurance over excitement.
Don't display exact body measurements anywhere user-facing. Bands, always.
Don't animate CSS layout properties (padding, margin, width, height, border-radius). Animate transform and opacity only.
Don't use bouncy or elastic easing curves. Stick to ease-out (default ease) at 0.2 to 0.45s durations.
Don't reach for a colored side-stripe to indicate state (info, warning, error). Use a full background tint, a leading icon, or a decisive border ring.
